title: Give the frantic mind a mantra
summary: This meets the mind scattering itself in ten directions at once. The line says the Perfect Guru quiets that roaming by placing the Lord's mantra at the center.
takeaway: Give the mind a steadier center.
lifeApplication: Before following the next distraction, say the mantra once and stay seated one breath longer. Let the mind be gathered before it is spent again.

source.shortMeaning: The roaming mind quiets when the Guru gives it the Lord's mantra.
source.lifeApplication: When attention fragments, return it to the mantra before chasing the next pull.

evidence.coreClaim: The roaming mind quiets when the Guru gives it the Lord's mantra.
evidence.turn: Love for the Lord gathers what distraction keeps scattering.
